name: Enchanté Artisan Aged French Cheese Cart (Comté, Beaufort & Tomme de Savoie)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Enchanté by Chef Arnaud Lallement
whyItWorks: Hard aged French alpine cheeses like 24-month Comté and Beaufort have ~0g residual lactose and zero fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the fromager for aged hard cheeses (Comté, Beaufort, aged Manchego/Mimolette) with plain white baguette slices; skip unripened triple-cream Brie and seeded/nut breads.
watchOuts: Skip soft unaged goat/triple-cream cheeses if lactose sensitive
